schema.description: A Store is a point of sale of a Merchant, with its own address, POS connection and payment configuration.

conceptStoreId.description: The ID of the Concept Store this Store belongs to.

conceptStoreName.description: The name of the Concept Store this Store belongs to. Returned only when `conceptStore` is requested through the `include` parameter. Retrieve the Concept Store from `/v1/concept_stores/{conceptStoreId}` to read its other fields.

storeAreaId.description: The ID of the Store Area this Store belongs to.

storeAreaName.description: The name of the Store Area this Store belongs to. Returned only when `storeArea` is requested through the `include` parameter. Retrieve the Store Area from `/v1/store_areas/{storeAreaId}` to read its other fields.

name.description: The display name of the Store.

slug.description: A URL-safe identifier for the Store, unique across the Merchant.

pos.description: The connection to the POS system that serves the Store. Setting it makes `externalId1` required.

posId.description: The identifier of the Store inside the POS system.

posEndpoint.description: The base URL of the POS system. A trailing slash is added when missing.

pos.title: Stores.StorePos

externalId1.description: Your own identifier for the Store, unique across the Merchant.

externalId2.description: A second identifier of your own for the Store, unique across the Merchant.

address.description: The postal address of the Store.
address.title: Stores.StoreLocation

paymentGatewayConfigurationId.description: The ID of the PaymentGatewayConfiguration used by this Store. When null, the Merchant default configuration applies.

ecommerceIsActive.description: Whether the Store accepts e-commerce orders.

ecommerceDeliveryIsActive.description: Whether the Store accepts e-commerce orders for delivery.

ecommercePickupIsActive.description: Whether the Store accepts e-commerce orders for pickup.

ecommerceReservationIsActive.description: Whether the Store accepts e-commerce reservations.

allOf.description: The outcome of the periodic health checks Voucherly runs against the Store POS connection.

status.description: The current health of the Store.

currentStatusFromUtc.description: The UTC timestamp when the Store entered the current status.

lastCheckedAtUtc.description: The UTC timestamp of the most recent health check.

lastSuccessAtUtc.description: The UTC timestamp of the most recent successful health check.

consecutiveKos.description: The number of consecutive failed health checks.

consecutiveOks.description: The number of consecutive successful health checks.

lastResponseTimeMs.description: The response time of the most recent health check, in milliseconds.

allOf.title: Stores.StoreStatus

status.description: The current health of the Store POS connection. Returned only when `status` is requested through the `include` parameter, and only for active Stores that have `pos` configured.

createdOnUtc.description: The UTC timestamp when the Store was created.

schema.title: Store
